name: fleet
description: fleet — fleet-wide operations across every machine registered with `agents devices`. `/fleet:onboard <device>` brings a bare new device up to fleet parity (agents-cli, agent CLIs, DotAgent repos, shared SSH key, PATH shim, device registration) and mints its agent auth in the same flow — the token-minting recipes are folded into the command itself. `/fleet:profile [menubar|daemon|doctor|sessions]` profiles a sluggish machine, attributes the load to agents-cli surfaces, and files a GitHub issue. Discovery-first, additive, idempotent, credentials via sanctioned paths only, never copied host-to-host.
